name: Dobbm
description: Dobbm is a traditional trick-taking game unique to the Stubai Valley in Tyrol, Austria. It is an 'Ace-Ten' game related to Tarock and Tapp, played with a 36-card Tell-pattern deck. The name refers to the 4-card talon known as the 'Dobb'.

overview.description: Dobbm is a traditional trick-taking game unique to the Stubai Valley in Tyrol, Austria. It is an 'Ace-Ten' game related to Tarock and Tapp, played with a 36-card Tell-pattern deck. The name refers to the 4-card talon known as the 'Dobb'.

history.origins: Dobbm is a hyper-local tradition centered in the village of Fulpmes. It was documented in 1996 by John McLeod and Remigius Geiser.
timeline: Traditional: Played for generations in the Stubai Valley.
1960s: Transition from Salzburger pattern cards to Doppeldeutsche (Tell) cards.
1996: formally documented for card game historians at Gasthof Jenewein.
history.cultural: Used as a major social catalyst in the Stubaital region across all generations.
history.evolution: Related to Brixental Bauerntarock and Zuger Tapp. It remains popular in Fulpmes while being virtually unknown in neighboring valleys like Wipptal.

setup.players: 4 active players. If 5 play, the dealer 'feiert' (takes a holiday) and sits out.
setup.deck: 36 German-suited (Tell) cards. Suits: Hearts, Leaves, Acorns, Bells.
setup.dealing: 8 cards to each player dealt in batches of 4. Four cards go face-down to the center as the 'Dobb'. The dealer for a hand is always the 'declarer' from the previous hand.

rules.objective: Win tricks to capture point cards and reach a target score. Points are: Ace/Sow (11), Ten (10), King (4), Ober (3), Unter (2). Total: 120 points per hand.
rules.gameplay:
1. Bidding: Players bid 'Ordinary' or 'Solo'. In an Ordinary game, the declarer takes the 'Dobb' and discards 4 cards (points count for them).
2. Trumps: Declarer names the trump suit.
3. The Dobb: In a Solo, the Dobb points count for the dealer (who is celebrating), not the soloist.
4. Card Play: Clockwise. Must follow suit. If unable, must play a trump if possible.
keyRules: The 6 of Bells ('Weli') is just a normal card in Dobbm.
Defenders can 'schieben' (smear) points on their partner's trick.

strategy.basic: As declarer, discard weak suits into the Dobb to create 'voids' for trumping.
strategy.intermediate: Use 'schinden' - defenders holding back high cards to win later tricks with established winners.
strategy.advanced: Recognize a 'Fuchs' (fox) - a single card in a suit that can be played to trick opponents into believing you have more of that suit.
tips: The Heart Sow is the most powerful trump starter.
Don't lead your top trumps immediately; force defenders to use theirs on side-suit tricks.

scoring.description: Points are counted from captured ace-ten cards and contract success.
scoring.winCondition: Highest cumulative score after agreed hands or local target wins.
